title: A New Way to look at Networking
summary: Van Jacobson's 2006 Google Tech Talk on rethinking networking around named content instead of host-to-host conversations. He recounts packet-networking history and lays out the content-centric networking idea that later became NDN.
why: HN commenters point to it as an inspiring talk behind content-addressed designs like IPFS, Urbit and immutable URLs.

quote.text: amazing and inspiring Google Talk video from 2006
